plan.title: SRC-AWD-024 line-wise award and approval rejection

steps.note: Open the existing closed two-bid event directly on Master QCS.
Enable the required eRFX project setting before accessing the prepared event.
Verify both bidding vendors are present in the comparison grid.
Verify Vendor A's requested quantity on the available line.
Verify Vendor A's bid rate on the available line.
Verify Vendor B's bid rate on the available line.
Verify the available line's amount and total arithmetic for Vendor B.
Verify the two vendor bids rank by lowest amount.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate the available line's full quantity to Vendor B, the closest expressible part of the requested line-wise allocation.
Verify the available allocation totals ₹900 and reflects one of two vendors selected.
Create the buyer-side award proposal from the available allocation.
Assert that the proposal page opened.
Fill mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the buyer-side proposal; approver rejection is not available in the catalog.
Assert that the proposal context remains visible after submission.
